tmp:3310: Markulis (Merculis) — the Roman idol Mercury, paradigm of idolatry served by stone-throwing; named as the archetypal avodah zarah
tmp:3313: the cessation of invading troops and wars — the state in which armies and warfare stop (so the vapors again produce rain, not bloodshed)
tmp:3314: the vapors/mists rising from the earth (Gen 2:6 'ed') — the meteorological-symbolic source from which rain is formed
tmp:3315: the principle that the greater the intellect — the measure of an expanded sekhel, which correspondingly shrinks time
tmp:3316: time diminishing and becoming nullified — the contraction of the category of time as intellect grows toward God who is above time
tmp:3317: mas'ei Bnei Yisrael — the journeys of the Children of Israel (Num 33:1), travels from place to place that atone for the blemish of idolatry
tmp:3318: that God grant us compassion (rachmanut) — the sought bestowal of divine mercy upon Israel through the journeys
tmp:3320: the drawing down of mercy (rachmanut) — compassion flowing from above as a result of atoning for the idolatry-blemish
tmp:3321: the sweetening of the charon af — mitigation of God's burning wrath aroused by the blemish of idolatry
tmp:3322: turning aside from God — the state of deviation from Hashem (flawed faith) that constitutes the blemish of idolatry
tmp:3323: nesiot — physical travels/journeyings from place to place, the concrete acts embodying 'the journeys of Bnei Yisrael' that atone
tmp:3324: mazon — food/sustenance ('food for all is in it,' Dan 4:9), nourishment flowing through the king-tree who holds the complete melody
tmp:3325: the clarification/separation of the human spirit from the animal spirit — effected by the shepherd's melody
tmp:3326: being saved from the animalistic spirit — the shepherd's rescue, via his melody, from descending to ruach ha-behemah
tmp:3327: the song and melody each shepherd knows — the unique niggun corresponding to the grasses and place where he pastures
tmp:3328: the melody's giving power to the grasses so there is pasture for the animals — niggun as vitalizer of vegetation and grazing
tmp:3329: onashim — punishments generally, all reckoned as an aspect of death (e.g., poverty, Ex 4:19), which uproot a person from the root of his vitality
tmp:3331: the act of coming to the tzaddik and seeing him (Isa 30:20) — beholding the tzaddik's face so as to find one's own middot reflected within him
tmp:3339: the 'head' of the Sitra Achra — the counterfeit chief of the Other Side, demonic counterpart to the tzaddik who is the head of holiness
tmp:3342: shem ha-kodesh — the holy divine Name, clothed and partnered within the tzaddik's name ('His Name is joined with our name')
tmp:3343: pe'er ve-hiddur — splendor and adornment (as in hiddur of the etrog), the beautification-quality flowing from the tzaddik who is the head
tmp:3344: the names of impurity of the chitzonim — defiled names belonging to the external/demonic forces, opposite the holy Name
tmp:3345: all the members of the generation — the people of the dor, who are all drawn from the tzaddik who is 'head' (koreh ha-dorot me-rosh)
tmp:3346: bnei bayit — members of the household: the generation as the 'house' relative to the tzaddik who is its rosh bayit (head of house)
tmp:3347: Noach — the biblical righteous man ('ish tzaddik tamim'), figure of the tzaddik who departs and is concealed, subject of the Bereishit-eulogy
tmp:3348: the endurance/upkeep of the houses and dwellings of Israel — sustained through the true tzaddik, the world's ba'al ha-bayit
tmp:3349: the endurance/sustenance of the Beit HaMikdash — the Temple's standing, maintained through the tzaddik (Yosef, rosh bayit)
tmp:3350: the endurance of Israel's dwellings — the preservation of Jewish homes, dependent on the tzaddik as master of the house
tmp:3351: being saved from fires/conflagrations — protection from destructive burning attained by mourning the Temple (subduing me'orei eish)
tmp:3354: mourning over the Beit HaMikdash — the practice of avelut for the destroyed Temple, whose initials hint 'kindle no fire in your dwellings'
tmp:3355: the subduing of the luminaries of fire (me'orei eish) and strengthening of the luminaries of light (me'orei or) — the Shabbat-light dynamic effected by mourning Zion
tmp:3356: the battim of the tefillin — the housings/boxes of the head-tefillin, 'house' vessels for the mochin/pe'er
tmp:3357: the revelation of the splendor and beauty of the true tzaddik — the event of his pe'er being disclosed, whereby mochin and sight are made and eyes opened
tmp:3358: the colors (gevanin) that shine in the Temple — the eye-colors/Shabbat-lights illuminating the Beit HaMikdash
tmp:3359: the magnification of the tzaddik's name — his fame growing in the world, within which God's own Name is clothed
tmp:3360: the magnification of God's Name (shemo yitbarakh) — the divine Name growing great as a consequence of the tzaddik's name growing great
tmp:3361: the revelation of this tzaddik — his becoming known and famous in the world, the 'shem' through which God's Name is magnified
tmp:3362: the capacity to see and gaze upon God's greatness and upon the world — opened eyes/power of sight granted through the tzaddik's revealed splendor
tmp:3363: the verse 'from there it divides and becomes four heads' (Gen 2:10) — the Eden-river splitting into four, source-text for the four elements/middot
tmp:3364: the four elements (fire, air, water, earth) — the arba yesodot from which all the character traits (middot) are drawn
